description: Use when assessing software category maturity, timing a market entry, or evaluating consolidation risk in a category. Returns market structure signal (consolidating or fragmenting) with citation evidence. Example: HR tech category — CONSOLIDATING signal, top 3 vendors hold 71% of AI citation share — late-stage consolidation signals pricing power shift to incumbents. Source: Stratalize market structure composite. $0.10 USDC per call.
